title: ResultSafe Core modularity policy
summary: Normative package-boundary, source-hygiene, direct-import, dependency, side-effect, integration, and packed-artifact requirements for the TypeScript core Result package.

invariants.requirement: The package MUST declare and resolve zero runtime dependencies.
invariants.observation: The exact packed core artifact resolved zero runtime dependencies in the local atomic modularity gate.

invariants.requirement: Every intended public source module MUST have a stable direct package subpath.
invariants.observation: The exact packed artifact passed all 66 declaration subpaths and all 45 runtime subpaths.

invariants.requirement: Every intended public export MUST remain available from the root and its owning direct subpath.
invariants.observation: The exact packed artifact passed root parity and all 66 registered direct subpaths.

invariants.requirement: Importing or using core MUST NOT require codecs, adapters, storage, or a runtime registry.
invariants.observation: The exact packed core passed dependency isolation with no mandatory integration path.

invariants.requirement: Root and direct imports MUST perform no observable import-time side effects.
invariants.observation: The exact packed artifact passed import-side-effect probes across its runtime surface.

invariants.requirement: Optional integrations MUST be published as separate packages and MUST NOT enter the core dependency graph.
invariants.observation: The exact packed core passed dependency isolation from the separately packed codec and Effect adapter.

invariants.requirement: All modularity claims MUST be proven against the exact packed artifact in isolated ESM, CJS, and declaration consumers.
invariants.observation: The exact packed artifact passed isolated ESM, CJS, declaration, closure, dependency, and side-effect checks.

invariants.requirement: Modularity remediation MUST preserve exactly 23 neutral Result operations and 88 Result conformance cells.
invariants.observation: The local atomic run preserved the 23-operation surface and exact 88-cell matrix while qualifying the packed core.

artifact_path_derivation.source_rule: For source path packages/core/fp/result/src/<relative>.ts, remove src/ and the .ts suffix to obtain <module>.
artifact_path_derivation.source_manifest_rule: For runtime modules derive types ./dist/types/<module>.d.ts, import ./dist/esm/<module>.js, and require ./dist/cjs/<module>.js; type-only modules derive only the types target.
artifact_path_derivation.packed_manifest_rule: The packed dist manifest removes exactly the leading ./dist/ segment from every source-manifest target and preserves the remaining path and condition unchanged.
artifact_path_derivation.root_exception: The root subpath uses <module> index and the existing root conditions; module records do not duplicate generated target strings.
artifact_path_derivation.umd_rule: UMD is a root browser bundle only and is not a direct-subpath format or proof of direct module importability.

payload.qualification_rule: A modularity invariant may be marked verified only after the exact tarball proves manifest closure, every registered root and direct import, declaration resolution, zero runtime dependencies, and no import-time side effects.
